headline: Going Commando's object tables gain sourced class labels
summary: Going Commando's dispatch tables now identify 198 object classes with attributed labels, covering 2,661 rows (#211, #212). The labels make entries such as fans and secret doors easier to find, while source qualifications distinguish identification from verified behaviour. This documentation work changes no game functions.
highlights: #210 proposed an external texture-pack comparison tool and closed without merging.
